column2: 3.1 Currency and completeness

Is there a pre-defined approach to ensure that metadata is kept up-to-date?

For Explanation:
* If yes, please briefly describe your approach.
column4: Part of the new poral ifrastructure is automated check of quality of data. This will be fully implementedy with new portal launch by the end of 2023.  SPARQL Endpoint enables data stewards to track quality of metadata by predefined or custom queries (https://opendata.mirri.tech/)* *updated
column7: Portal has automated check of quality of metadata. Reports are made every 24 hours. Reports can be downloaded here: https://github.com/datova-kancelaria/nkod-dokumentacia/blob/main/pouz%CC%8Ci%CC%81vatel%CC%8Cska%CC%81%20pri%CC%81ruc%CC%8Cka.md#soubory-s-csv-reporty-v%C3%BDsledk%C5%AF-m%C4%9B%C5%99en%C3%AD-kvality-a-dostupnosti

column2:
What percentage of the metadata on the national portal is obtained from the source automatically, rather than edited manually? 

For Explanation:
* Please describe (1) the workflows you have to automate the harvesting of metadata and (2) for which types of data these apply to
column7: aprox 18%.  Metadata are harvested from registered local catalogs: https://data.slovensko.sk/lokalne-katalogy. Publisher can register local catalog when logged in with eID. We support 3 types of local catalogs - SPARQL, CKAN, DCAT-AP Dokumenty. Harvesting is done every night with LinkedPipes technology (same as czech portal) - data are stored in RDF database. All metadata are harvested which are compatible with DCAT-AP-SK 2.

column2:

For Explanation:
* Please explain the approach for updating metadata in a timely manner

Do you undertake efforts to ensure that published data covers the full period from when it was first published until today, for example,the complete time series?

For Explanation:
* If yes, please explain the measures in place to ensure complete series of datasets
column7: We implemented dcat:temporal and data series type of dataset in our DCAT-AP. This helps providers and us to analyze metadata more efficiently and spot if some data seems to be missing. We also promote local catalogs with automated processing from providers information systems, this ensures no data is missing.

column2: 3.2 Monitoring and measures

Do you monitor the quality of the metadata available on your portal?

For Explanation:
* If yes, please briefly explain how this monitoring takes place. 
* If applicable, please provide the URL to this monitoring mechanism.
column4: Monitoring is automated and launched daily.  Acces is possible via SPARQL endpoint (in future with dashboard) with predefined queries.https://opendata.mirri.tech/
column7: There are detailed reports available (see Q1), there is also Metadata quality page which lists some of the most important reports data.slovensko.sk/kvalita-metadat

column2:
Do you publish information on the quality of the metadata available on the portal?

For Explanation:

column4:
Yes, via SPARQL endpoint (DCAT-AP-SK definds quality). https://opendata.mirri.tech/ Annual report is carried out on publishing datasets and quality of datasets and metadata on national open data portal. column2: 3.3 DCAT-AP Compliance

Does the national portal follow the DCAT-AP framework or, if not, are standards in place to ensure interoperability with DCAT-AP?

For explanation:
* If the  portal follow the DCAT-AP framework, please describe how compliance with DCAT-AP is ensured
* If the portal does not follow the DCAT-AP framework, please describe how interoperability with DCAT-AP is ensured
column7: yes, national portal follows DCAT-AP, we use our national extension DCAT-AP-SK 2.0.1. which is regularly updated (there is 3.0 version in final development)

column2: What is the percentage of metadata on your portal that is DCAT-AP compliant, in terms of mandatory classes? (agent, catalogue, dataset, literal, resource)
What is the percentage of metadata on your portal that uses DCAT-AP recommended classes? (category, category scheme, distribution, licence document)
What is the percentage of metadata on your portal that uses DCAT-AP optional classes? (catalogue record, checksum, document, frequency)

Is there a national extension of the DCAT-AP standard developed for your country? 

For Explanation:
* If yes, please (1) briefly outline the reasons for this decision, and (2) what the main differences between the national variation and the EU standard are.
* If applicable, please provide the URL to the documentation of the national DCAT-AP extension.
column4: https://datova-kancelaria.github.io/dcat-ap-sk-2.0/ Response to reviewer: The main difference is more detailed metadata for licences (the Slovakian version of DCAT is very similar to the Czech).

column2:
Do you investigate the most common causes for the lack of DCAT-AP compliance?

For Explanation:

column7: Yes, most common lack of compliance is caused by lack of training for public officers or lack of time to dive deeper into data quality issues.
